subject: Subprocessor onboarding: Order Form amendment + evidence access
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cloudhaven.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Giovanni Rossi <contracts@cloudhaven.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed addition of EdgeSync as subprocessor / redlines attached

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Per our internal review, CloudHaven intends to add a new subprocessor (EdgeSync, managed CDN and log routing) that will touch encrypted telemetry and a subset of customer metadata needed for routing. We attached: 1) redlined MSA with the subprocessor clause highlighted, and 2) EdgeSync's Subprocessor Statement.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm Redwood's acceptance of EdgeSync under the current DPA framework (we propose EdgeSync as a category-level subprocessor listed in the order form amendment).
- If Redwood requires a DPA annex or additional flow-down language, specify exact wording so we can update and re-upload to DocuSign.
- We can provide time-limited evidence access for SOC2 and encryption attestations — need to know evidence bucket and contact for escrow viewing.

Attaching: CloudHaven_MSA_redlines_20261101.pdf; EdgeSync_subproc_statement_v1.docx

Sincerely,
Sara Patel
Legal Operations | CloudHaven
---
Forwarded attachment: CloudHaven redlines (summary page)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed addition of EdgeSync as subprocessor / redlines attached

Sara,

Appreciate the materials — joining Kimberly (Legal) and Markus (Procurement) to run the redlines and confirm next steps. Quick summary of what we'll validate on our side:
1) Whether EdgeSync can be accepted under our standard DPA annex or needs a scoped order-form addendum (data categories + residency caveats).
2) Any requested flow-down obligations (encryption, incident notification times, right to audit) that differ from our current MSA/DPA.
3) Evidence access: procurement/legal need to know if CloudHaven will: (a) provide read-only SOC2 + pen-test reports via secure bucket, or (b) provide platform-level temporary accounts for escrow review.

Markus — can you confirm whether we need an Order Form amendment for this subprocessor addition (commercial/price impact)?
Kimberly — if you see non-standard redlines in the MSA, flag exact clause language we must push back on.

Proposed timeline: 72-hour legal triage, procurement impact note by EOD Thu, then a mutual action plan to finalize DocuSign changes by 11/10.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed addition of EdgeSync as subprocessor / redlines attached

Circling back after a quick redline pass. High level notes:
- Redline concern: the proposed MSA change expands "authorized subcontractors" without a clear audit covenant. We should require either (A) EdgeSync is added as an explicitly named subprocessor in the Order Form, or (B) CloudHaven confirms they will flow down all DPA obligations to EdgeSync and provide a signed annex.
- Incident notification: request to tighten to 24 hours for incidents affecting customer-identifying metadata.
- Audit & evidence: rather than temporary platform accounts, we prefer a secure evidence bundle (S3 presigned URL or shared Drive link) that includes: SOC2 type II, last 12 months of change control logs relevant to data access, pen-test summary, and a statement of key custody (KMS/HSM).

Can CloudHaven provide date-limited presigned URLs or a dedicated evidence bucket (read-only) for legal/infosec review? If so, produce a list of files and the contact for access. If CloudHaven insists on platform accounts, propose limit to read-only with no export.

Markus — procurement impact?

-Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Giovanni Rossi <contracts@cloudhaven.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@cloudhaven.com>, EdgeSync Ops <onboarding@edgesync.io>
Date: 2026-11-09T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed addition of EdgeSync as subprocessor / redlines attached

Hi Kimberly & team,

Thanks for the detailed pass. Quick answers:
- We can add EdgeSync as a named subprocessor on an Order Form amendment and will flow down DPA obligations; we will provide a signed EdgeSync annex.
- Incident notification: CloudHaven can accept 24-hour notification for metadata-impacting incidents. We'll keep our platform controls for root-level admin access but will provide a signed statement of segregation for EdgeSync.
- Evidence access: we prefer to provide a time-limited, read-only evidence package via presigned S3 links. We'll compile: SOC2 Type II (last report), pen-test executive summary, KMS custody statement, and an operational attestation from EdgeSync. Expect upload by 11/12.

DocuSign: I've created an Order Form amendment draft and opened a PowerForm for signature — link below. We need Redwood to confirm the final scope (named subprocessor, list of data categories) then we'll finalize.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=abcd1234

Regards,
Giovanni Rossi
Contracts Manager | CloudHaven

- By 2026-11-13: Redwood legal to triage uploaded docs and flag any substantive gaps (Kimberly).
- By 2026-11-15: Finalize Order Form amendment with EdgeSync named, data categories listed, incident notification at 24h, and DPA annex appended. DocuSign powerform will be used for signatures. — Giovanni / Neha
